name: Cars
summary: What each car is: engine curve, gears, mass, aero, brakes, driver aids, tyre choice. Car specs are JSON in data/.
notes: New cars are new JSON files; class_tag is the car class (GT3, Road). CarCatalog.classes() / ids_in_class() group them. Upgrades and tuning use CarDefinition.with_overrides(). Cars that never race (the safety car) live in special/ and load with CarCatalog.load_safety_car(). Car setups (wave 4): CarSetup lists the 21 settings, their ranges and plain explanations, and turns a setup ({"tuning": {...}} in the overrides) into physical numbers.
